suites.title: AE-1 Product search and catalogue on the shop and the public product API

specs.title: SCN-001: A client lists the catalogue through the API

steps.title: Given the public product API (no authentication)
When a client calls GET /api/productsList
Then the response lists the products of the catalogue in a "products" array

specs.title: SCN-002: Every catalogue product carries id, name, price, brand and category with audience and category name

steps.title: Given the public product API (no authentication)
When a client calls GET /api/productsList
Then every product has an "id", a "name", a "price", a "brand" and a "category"
And every category holds the audience "usertype" and the category name

specs.title: SCN-003: Every catalogue price is written as "Rs. " followed by the amount

steps.title: Given the public product API (no authentication)
When a client calls GET /api/productsList
Then every price is written as "Rs. " followed by the amount, e.g. "Rs. 500"

specs.title: SCN-004: Searching "jean" through the API returns exactly the three jeans

steps.title: Given the public product API (no authentication)
When a client posts search_product = "jean" to /api/searchProduct
Then exactly these products are returned: "Soft Stretch Jeans", "Regular Fit Straight Jeans", "Grunt Blue Slim Fit Jeans"

specs.title: SCN-005.1: Search ignores letter case (TOP / top)

steps.title: Given the public product API (no authentication)
When a client searches for "TOP" and for "top"
Then both searches return the same products

specs.title: SCN-005.2: Search ignores letter case (Top / top)

steps.title: Given the public product API (no authentication)
When a client searches for "Top" and for "top"
Then both searches return the same products

specs.title: SCN-006: Searching "dress" returns every product with "dress" in its name or in a Dress category

steps.title: Given the catalogue from GET /api/productsList
[SEED] catalogue (GET /api/productsList)
When a client searches for "dress"
Then every catalogue product whose name contains "dress" is returned
And every product in a "Dress" category is returned, including "Sleeves Top and Short - Blue & Pink" (Kids > Dress)

specs.title: SCN-007: Searching "dress" returns nothing else

steps.title: Given the catalogue from GET /api/productsList
[SEED] catalogue (GET /api/productsList)
When a client searches for "dress"
Then every product returned has "dress" in its name or its category name

specs.title: SCN-008: The brand is not a search field

steps.title: Given the catalogue from GET /api/productsList
[SEED] catalogue (GET /api/productsList)
When a client searches for "Polo"
Then exactly the products with "Polo" in their name or category name are returned

specs.title: SCN-009: A search that matches nothing returns an empty product list

steps.title: Given the public product API (no authentication)
When a client searches for "zzqxv"
Then an empty product list is returned

specs.title: SCN-010: A search that matches nothing is not an error

steps.title: Given the public product API (no authentication)
When a client searches for "zzqxv"
Then the response is not an error: no error status and no error message

specs.title: SCN-011: Searching with an empty value returns the whole catalogue

steps.title: Given the catalogue from GET /api/productsList
[SEED] catalogue (GET /api/productsList)
When a client posts search_product with an empty value
Then the whole catalogue is returned, the same products as GET /api/productsList

specs.title: SCN-013: A search without the search_product parameter explains what is missing

steps.title: Given the public product API (no authentication)
When a client posts to /api/searchProduct without the search_product parameter
Then the message is "Bad request, search_product parameter is missing in POST request."

specs.title: SCN-014: A shopper searches "jean" on the Products page

steps.title: Given a shopper on the Products page
When they type "jean" in the search box and press the search button
Then the product grid is headed "Searched Products"
And the search box still shows "jean"
And exactly the three jeans products listed in AC-2 are shown

specs.title: SCN-015: A shopper searches without a term on the Products page and sees the whole catalogue

steps.title: Given a shopper on the Products page
When they leave the search box empty and press the search button
Then the grid is headed "All Products"
And every product of the catalogue (GET /api/productsList) is shown
[SEED] catalogue (GET /api/productsList)

specs.title: SCN-016.1: The shop and the API agree on search results (top)

steps.title: Given a shopper on the Products page
When a shopper searches for "top" on the Products page
Then the products shown are exactly the products POST /api/searchProduct returns for "top"

specs.title: SCN-016.2: The shop and the API agree on search results (dress)

steps.title: Given a shopper on the Products page
When a shopper searches for "dress" on the Products page
Then the products shown are exactly the products POST /api/searchProduct returns for "dress"

specs.title: SCN-016.3: The shop and the API agree on search results (Men Tshirt)

steps.title: Given a shopper on the Products page
When a shopper searches for "Men Tshirt" on the Products page
Then the products shown are exactly the products POST /api/searchProduct returns for "Men Tshirt"

specs.title: SCN-017: A search on the Products page that matches nothing shows no product

steps.title: Given a shopper on the Products page
When a shopper searches for "zzqxv" on the Products page
Then the grid is headed "Searched Products"
And no product is shown
